verdict.rationale: Morph lets developers build with existing official vendor SDKs: any OpenAI SDK works against its OpenAI-compatible base URL, and it natively serves the Anthropic Messages API. A hands-on user confirmed the compatible endpoint works with their own CLI tool, and the docs have an `/sdk/components` section. However, the evidence never shows a first-party, Morph-published SDK package, so this is compatibility with other vendors' SDKs rather than official Morph SDKs. Missing for 10: an evidenced first-party Morph SDK package with install and reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration of SDK coverage for the specialized tools.
